name: DAAD EPOS
eligibilitySummary: For graduates from developing countries with at least two years of professional experience.
coverage: 934 EUR/month + travel allowance and health insurance

name: Erasmus+ Grant
eligibilitySummary: For students undertaking a semester/year abroad or a joint master's degree within the EU.
coverage: Approx. 300 - 600 EUR/month depending on the host country
deadline: Depends on the home university's internal deadlines

name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships
eligibilitySummary: For international students who show outstanding academic record and social/political engagement.

name: Deutschlandstipendium
eligibilitySummary: Merit-based scholarship for high-achieving students enrolled at participating German universities.

name: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung (KAS) Scholarships
eligibilitySummary: For international students demonstrating academic excellence and a strong interest in politics/society.

name: Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung Scholarships
eligibilitySummary: For international students with high academic and professional qualifications, engaged in social, political or community activities.
